program_name: Diploma in English for Professional Communication

fees.notes: Official IUKL (now KLUST) international fee schedule effective 26 Apr 2022, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20220627135640id_/https://iukl.edu.my/iukl-application-forms/Undergraduate-International-fee-structure.pdf?v=20220513: tuition RM26,040 total for Diploma in English for Professional Communication (2.5 years, RM280/credit); approximate all-in programme fee RM36,300. Current KLUST site (checked 2026-09-18) no longer publishes programme fees ('Ask us').

requirements.general: Any of these: SPM: Minimum 3Cs (including English). O-Level: Minimum 3Cs (including English). UEC: Minimum 3Bs (including English). Certificate / SKM III: Minimum CGPA of 2.00 with a C in English SPM. Other Qualifications: As recognized by the Senate of IUKL as equivalent to SPM Note: Students without a C in English SPM must take IELTS or its equivalent. ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT (INTERNATIONAL):  IELTS - 5 TOEFL (PBT) - 500 TOEFL (IBT) - 42 PTE - 47 MUET - BAND 3 Cambridge English - 154
